scope: All15 multiport versions in current94-version original persistent library; design sidecar only, no new physical experiment or candidate promotion.
approval_interpretation: No current item is auto-approved for the new artistic/meaningful-choice junction brief; promising seeds are proposals for redesign, not judgments that existing actions are invalid.
criteria: Distinct onward destinations or exchange responsibilities, not port count.
An interpretable shared decision situation, with timing/resources/world state that actually allow choosing.
Spatial silhouette, approach/readability, hierarchy and recognizable local landmark; reviewer arguments rather than fabricated scalar fun scores.
Intentional asymmetric relations need explicit design and direction/state evidence; UNKNOWN does not mean one-way.
Recovery is valuable but alone does not justify an extra map-junction arm.
Shared support can form a good T-junction when destination roles and composition exist; it is not intrinsically a defect.
Sequential waypoints or nested route prefixes are not separate onward choices.

reading_scope: Read all15 original library records/documents and42 route cases, current branch/generation rules and existing evidence review; checked record/doc/case hashes and shared physical/reward identity. Actually viewed3 canonical SVG rasterizations. Did not watch physical videos, re-run Godot, re-judge original regular statistics or test new one-way claims.
key_findings: Six variants primarily remain action challenge plus lower-risk/recovery outlet.
Three four-port variants need junction redesign; their extra low ports lack explicit onward region duties and spatial decision composition. Shared ground alone is not a rejection reason.
Four high/low or left/right investment variants contain promising directional/resource choice skeletons; their reward endpoints need genuine onward duties.
Two Macros provide an authored layered excursion/return loop, but first-box C and later-box B are nested visits rather than two independent map destinations.
All76 unverified pairs remain UNKNOWN; zero no_path claims in the existing contracts.
